id: title:Gilbert09:retry delta vacuum on commit conflict

review.posthog_relevance: Adds conflict-aware retry and typed reuse for warehouse table maintenance, preventing premature failure when concurrent transactions invalidate the vacuum's read set.
review.reason: Replaces direct call to table.vacuum with execute_with_conflict_retry, wrapping the vacuum call in a retry loop. Adds TypeVar and its use in execute_with_conflict_retry, and updates docstring to include vacuum alongside merge/optimize.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of a bounded reliability improvement (retry wrapper and typing support). The tier does not account for unverified outcomes such as actual incident avoidance or adoption, which are not demonstrated in the supplied hunk.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
